mentions.name: Anti-spam bot plugin for messengers
mentions.description: An anti-spam bot plugin for messengers, starting with an MVP for Telegram. It uses a data pipeline that computes word-frequency weights ('small-language models'), performs morphological analysis of words across languages by porting the rule-based pymorphy2 library, relies on a DAWG data structure ported from C++ to Haskell, and includes a small language model built from a corpus of thousands of spam messages.
mentions.problem: Spam is prevalent in messengers, and Telegram's business model makes it especially common there.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Anti-spam bot plugin for messengers:

- MVP version for Telegram (since spamming is a part of their business model, it feels natural to start with it)

- More precisely, data pipeline for weights and measurements for word frequencies. Think of it as small-language models.
